Equal-Sums Strips Magic Square Generator

Orders 12-108 * Strips: 2x3, 3x4, 2x5, 4x7, etc.

Created by Inder J. Taneja

Options

Verified constructions using 1 through n² exactly once. Smaller rectangular strips are used wherever verified: 2x3, 3x3, 3x4, 2x5, 2x7, and other suitable divisions. Wider strips remain only for orders where this collection has no smaller verified construction. Every row, column and both diagonals share the magic sum; every rectangular strip has the same total.

Magic square

Strip verification

These checks concern the total of each strip. Individual rows and columns inside a strip may have different sums.
